summary: n people in a row each toss a biased coin (heads prob p); X_n = number of heads, Y_n = number of people whose result differs from right neighbor; find P(Y_n=1|X_n=1), E and Var of Y_n (indicator sums with dependence), and prove Y_n/n converges in distribution and find its limit (WLLN/Chebyshev).
